# netcup_clouddns_revision (Data Source)

One revision of a domain on CloudDNS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_clouddns_revision" "active" {
  domain_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) Id of the domain.

### Optional

- `identifier` (String) Identifier of the revision. Defaults to the active one.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `modified_at` (String) Time of the last change.
- `serial` (Number) Serial of the revision, if it has one.
- `state` (String) State of the revision.
